ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the dashed line represents the planned highway line, and the solid curves represent contour lines; values such as 300, 500, 700, and 900 are marked on the contour lines. The four places Jia, Yi, Bing, and Ding are all located on or near the dashed planned highway line. Jia is on the left side of the figure, with relatively low contour values nearby; Yi is near the dashed line in the middle-left part, and a 300 contour line can be seen beside it; Bing is in the upper part of the middle-right, with higher contour lines nearby, close to the area where the 700 contour line is located; Ding is near the dashed line on the right side, and a 500 contour line can be seen beside it. Among the four places, the area where Bing is located has the highest contour value, so the one with the highest altitude is Bing.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the planning route design map of a highway in a mountainous area of China, and answer the question.

<image1>

Among the four places Jia, Yi, Bing, and Ding along the highway in the figure, which place has the highest altitude?

method.method_draft: First describe the map elements: dashed line is the planned road, solid curves are contour lines with labels. For each of 甲、乙、丙、丁, read the nearest contour values or the contour interval region containing the point. Estimate their relative elevations from those nearby contour labels. Compare the four estimated elevations; 丙 is located by the highest-valued contour region among the four, so the highest point is 丙.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中用虚线表示规划公路线，用实线曲线表示等高线，等高线上标有数值，如300、500、700、900等。甲、乙、丙、丁四地都位于或靠近虚线公路线沿线。甲在图左侧，附近等高线数值较低；乙在中左部虚线附近，旁边可见300等高线；丙在中右部偏上，附近有较高的等高线，接近700等高线所在区域；丁在右侧虚线附近，旁边可见500等高线。
推理：比较四地附近等高线数值，乙约在300米附近，甲也处在较低等高线附近，丁约在500米附近，而丙靠近700米左右的较高等高线区域。四地中丙所在区域等高线数值最高，因此海拔最高的是丙。

method.method_draft: Start at 甲 and trace the dashed road in order.
